keywords: how to make a nether portal
entries.answer: Build a frame of obsidian, 4 wide and 5 tall (the corners can be left out, so 10 blocks), then light the inside with a flint and steel. Obsidian needs a diamond or netherite pickaxe. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

In 1.18 and newer, diamonds are most common deep down around Y -59 to -50. Strip mine or branch mine at about Y -58, bring an iron pickaxe or better, and keep water or blocks handy for lava. Fortune on the pickaxe gives more. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Ancient debris is found in the Nether, most often around Y 15 (anything between 8 and 22 works). Mine it with a diamond pickaxe or better. Smelt it into scrap, then 4 scrap + 4 gold ingots makes 1 netherite ingot. Upgrade diamond gear at a smithing table with a netherite upgrade template. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)
Press F3 (on some laptops Fn+F3). The XYZ line is your position. Y is the height. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

keywords: how to use an enchanting table
entries.answer: Put your item and lapis lazuli in an enchanting table. For level 30 enchants, surround the table with 15 bookshelves, one block gap between them and the table. Use an anvil to combine enchanted items or books. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Mending can't come from an enchanting table. Get it from villager trades (a librarian), fishing, or treasure chests. It repairs the item using XP you pick up. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Elytra are only found in End Cities, in the item frame on End ships, so you have to reach the outer End islands. Fix them with phantom membranes. Fireworks rockets give you a speed boost while gliding. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

keywords: how to get to the end
entries.answer: Craft eyes of ender (blaze powder + ender pearl) and throw them, they float toward the nearest stronghold. Dig down there to find the end portal room. Put an eye in each of the 12 frames to open it. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

keywords: how to beat the ender dragon
entries.answer: Destroy the end crystals on the pillars first (a bow works, watch out for the caged ones), because they heal the dragon. Then hit it with melee when it perches on the portal, or shoot it with a bow. Bring a water bucket for endermen, and a pumpkin on your head helps. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Feed two adults of the same animal their food and they make a baby. Wheat for cows, sheep and mooshrooms, seeds for chickens, carrots for pigs, and golden apples or carrots for horses. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Wolves: feed bones until hearts appear. Cats and ocelots: raw cod or salmon, slowly. Horses: keep getting on until they stop bucking you off, then add a saddle. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Craft it with a nether star, 3 obsidian and 5 glass. The nether star drops from the Wither. Put it on top of a pyramid of iron, gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks (1 to 4 layers), and clear the sky above it. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Sharpness V, Unbreaking III, Mending, Looting III and Sweeping Edge III. Fire Aspect is a good extra. Sharpness is the main damage one, you can't have it with Smite or Bane of Arthropods. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Efficiency V, Unbreaking III, Mending and either Fortune III (more drops from ores) or Silk Touch (keeps the ore block). You can't have Fortune and Silk Touch together. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

A creeper hisses before it explodes, so back away or hit it and retreat. Cats scare them off, and well-lit areas stop them spawning. Shield or blocking with a sword also helps. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Don't fight it. The warden hunts by sound and vibration, so sneak, place wool around sculk sensors and avoid shriekers. If it chases you, run away and block it off. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)

Mob farms or a spawner farm give the most XP, smelting lots of items in furnaces is easy, and mining ores and breeding animals help too. Enchanted tools with Mending also use up XP orbs, so keep a spare tool off for XP. (General Minecraft, not MineBerry-specific.)
